retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, gritty portrait of a male artist paired with a motorcycle, featuring heavy distressed textures and a mix of sharp blackletter and typewriter typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a male figure in a leather jacket and bandana, positioned off-center against a rustic background with a motorcycle. The entire image is unified by a heavy, scratched, and folded paper texture with high-contrast, warm-toned lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject dominance through high-contrast lighting against a darker background
Textural unity between the foreground subject and the background environment
Typographic hierarchy using scale and distinct stylistic contrast
Diagonal movement from the subject's gaze toward the motorcycle in the background
coreInvariants: Heavy white scratch and fold texture overlays across the entire frame
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and warm highlights
Combination of a large stylized script and a smaller mechanical font

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject is positioned on the right third of the frame, medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large white script in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script, moves to the subject's face, follows the body down to the motorcycle in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Utilized in the upper left and center to allow for prominent typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in shadows and leather textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm ochre and tan tones in the background and skin highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted pink/red in the bandana and stark white for typography and scratches.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with desaturated, earthy color palette.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses sharp, elongated vertical strokes with calligraphic flourishes
Subtitle text uses slab-serif, monospaced typewriter forms with slight ink-bleed effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 't' and 'l' in display text feature exaggerated vertical height
Typewriter 'o' and 'c' show irregular edge distressing
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of expressive, sharp script with rigid, mechanical typewriter text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp, aggressive calligraphic feel of the display text
Provides the necessary mechanical, raw contrast for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man in a leather jacket and bandana standing next to a motorcycle in a rustic garage setting. Apply a heavy distressed texture of white scratches and paper folds over the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, sharp white blackletter-style script in the upper left. Below it, add a single line of small white typewriter-style text.

verificationChecks: Is the texture overlay visible across both the subject and the background?
Is the display text significantly larger and more stylized than the subtitle?
Are all text elements rendered in solid white?
Does the lighting maintain high contrast with deep shadows?

mustRedesign: Do not use bright or neon colors
Ensure the subject does not look overly polished or studio-lit

avoid: Perfectly straight, clean edges on text

postGenerationChecks: Check that the scratch texture does not obscure the subject's face excessively.
Verify the typewriter text is legible despite the distressing.
Ensure the blackletter script feels integrated into the composition.
Confirm the color palette remains earthy and muted.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast gritty portrait with a dual-font typographic system (sharp script + typewriter) and a global distressed paper texture overlay.
